title: Cancelling is not possible, Only Renewal
body:
Cancel Button Nonexistent, Only Renewal is Possible

Be warned: Renewing is the only available option for your Premium account 

Although it may appear that you can deactivate your account at any time, the reality is quite different. If you decide to deactivate later, you will find no option to do so. Furthermore, when attempting to delete your account, you will be prompted to cancel it first. However, the supposed 'Cancel' button does not exist. It cannot be found under Settings, Premium options, or anywhere else.

Once you are in, there is seemingly no way out.

title: Tried many. This is best overall
body:
I tried many to-do management apps over time, from simple to  complex, and settled a couple of years ago on TickTick.
The 3 key advantages are usability/flexibility, scalability (from simple task list to complex filters), and multi platform (macOS, iOS, web, …).
I wished the UI was as polished as Apple-only competitors, but that’s a small price to pay.
Highly recommended.

title: All around amazing app
body:
This app is awesome! Sleek design, great UI, super useful, customizable, organized and super easy to navigate! On top of that come features like the pomodoro counter, which are just super useful! I have the app on my mac too, and there've been no sync issues so far. This app completely decimates all competition (Microsoft to do etc.). 

Only thing that is missing would be a sort of “homework feature”, where you can enter a due date but plan on doing the task before its due. Maybe an option to create sub tasks with individual deadlines would be a solution? (Ex. essay due in one week, sub tasks: research on thursday and friday, outline on monday, writing the essay on tuesday and wednesday.) When sub tasks are completed, the main task is also automatically completed. Some sort of feature like that would really kick the greatness of this app into the stars.

title: missing deadline feature
body:
This App has everything I need besides a deadline feature. When I add tasks, I add the deadline as a date so I know when homework is due or when a project is due, since I’m a student. Because of this, I can’t actually get much use out if the Today feature because I have to actually finish the task before the day I have to hand it in. Without an additional deadline feature I can’t put add the task to another day because that way I won’t know when it is due. This app would be the perfect app if I could add a deadline and a different date on which i want to complete the task. This is the only missing feature keeping me from switching from Things 3 to this App for good. 

The Pomodoro and calendar features are just amazing and so useful.
